description: Get a sector's policy guardrails as Rego source (free), with policies[].inputs listing the record types and input fields each policy reads — e-ledger fields such as co2e_kg and direction, not canonical Open Footprint field names; a payload without them is reported unevaluable by ofp_validate. When a sector has no published guardrails this returns published:false with a reason — that is a real answer, not an error. Treat it as "no rules are published", never as "there are no constraints", and do not invent guardrails to fill the gap.
name: ofp_policies
title: ofp_policies
